description: Authenticates a domain to send email through Wayfarel's email service (Brevo): the ownership code, the two DKIM signing CNAMEs, a DMARC policy to start with, and the Brevo sender in the SPF record (merged into the existing SPF record, never replacing it). Each part is its own group so a domain that already has a DMARC policy keeps it.
variableDescription: brevocode: ownership code published as brevo-code:<brevocode> (letters and digits). dkimzone: the domain name with dots replaced by dashes, as used by Brevo in the DKIM CNAME targets b1.<dkimzone>.dkim.brevo.com and b2.<dkimzone>.dkim.brevo.com.
